The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 e0e35c0328f2caef), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 20. statement: Let p: Y → X be a projective bimeromorphic morphism of normal irreducible compact Kähler fourfolds, where Y has ordinary terminal singularities. Let Q = Sm j=1 Qj be a reduced union of distinct irreducible divisors satisfying dim p(Q) ≤ 1. Then the sum defining β(Q) and the count defining τY (Q) are finite, and (5.3) β(Q) ≤ m X j=1 c2(Qν j ) + τY (Q). The rank c2(Qν j ) is the rational rank spanned in H4(Qν j , Q) by the fundamental classes of compact irreducible analytic surfaces.
